headline:
Are Foreclosures
Really Going Up?
titan_answer: One tracker counts 21 percent more properties with a foreclosure filing in the first half of 2026 than the first half of 2025.
summary: So a filing isn't losing the house. The report calls the broader picture a market gradually returning to more typical patterns.
disclaimer: A July report on the first half of 2026. Not a prediction, and it says nothing about any one homeowner. Foreclosure rules are a question for an attorney.
